SSC JE Engineer Final Result 2026

Post Date: August 3, 2026

12:38 pm

Staff Selection Commission (SSC), has released the Final Result on the official website for the Recruitment of the Junior Engineer Examination 2026. The tier-II exam was conducted on 07 April 2026, and the last date to submit the application form was 21 July 2025. Candidates Can Also Check the Final Result using their Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth by logging into the portal. The direct link is provided below.
